full_judgment: 7. On perusal of the aforesaid gazettes, we find that Uttar Kistakathi has not been included within Jhalokathi Pourashava. We notice that except the voter list, a khatian of J.L. No. 137 along with the mouja map, some receipts and a certificate, which are not legal documents  to infer that Uttar kistakathi is within the Pourashava, there is no legal document to come to the conclusion that Uttar Kistakhati is part and parcel of Jhalokathi Pourashava. In view of the matter, we find no illegality in the judgment of the High Court Division in directing the Election Commission to correct the voter list and exclude 672 voters of Uttar Kistakathi and then to hold election. However, we would like to add that if the Ministry of Local Government, Rural Development and  Co-operatives, the respondent No.2, can publish gazette notification in accordance with Pourashava Election Rules including Uttar Kistakathi within the Jhalokathi Pourashava in the intervening period of publication of gazette notification declaring election schedule as per direction of the High Court Division, there would be no bar to hold election as per voter list published including those 672 voters of Uttar Kistakathi.
